findings.message: Scope in says only 'the next confirmed seeds permitted by the remaining Phase 3 registry'. It never names what to emit. Under the registry the head admission is `daemon-soak`, which must be authored ALONE as KNOWN-DEEP (`high`/`high`). The emitted set is therefore exactly `daemon-soak` plus its numbered tail `phase3-continue-20`. Neither stem, their depends edges, their tiers, their budgets, nor the daemon-soak fence (`eval/daemon_soak.py`, `squatch/artifacts.py`, `tests/test_daemon_soak.py`, registering the closed report) is stated, so the implementer has to reconstruct the batch identity from the plan.
findings.paved_road: Name the exact batch in Scope in: `daemon-soak` (source seed, confirmed, P1, high/high, depends on phase3-continue-19, plan contract section 20, fence `eval/daemon_soak.py`, `squatch/artifacts.py`, `tests/test_daemon_soak.py`) and `phase3-continue-20` (medium/medium, owns `tickets` plus `tests/test_seeded_phase3_20.py`, depends on daemon-soak, successor admissions `[[soak-run], [phase3-exit]]`). Add an ownership YAML block like the one in phase3-continue-11/12.

findings.message: Section 20 requires every continuation's seeded test to do seven things: pin exact emitted identities, edges, tier, and budget; assert every existing fence path is existing Context; name each new module's registry owner; check predecessor-test closure; carry the shrinking suffix; keep the batch within `seeding.max_seeds_per_admission`; and keep a max-effort synthetic render within `REQ_RENDER_HEADROOM`. The criteria only cover the ordered admissions/suffix and the Context partition. Nothing requires tests/test_seeded_phase3_19.py to pin identities, tiers, or budgets, the new-path owners (`eval/daemon_soak.py`, `tests/test_daemon_soak.py`, `tests/test_seeded_phase3_20.py`), fence-in-Context, predecessor-test closure, the seeding cap, authoring-time Context sizes, or the max-effort render. The Definition of rejected cites 'a render over headroom', but no criterion or verification step enforces it.
findings.paved_road: Add acceptance criteria, following phase3-continue-12's criteria and tests/test_seeded_phase3_11.py. The test must pin the exact seeds, depends edges, high/high vs medium/medium tiers, 75/150 budgets within `drain.max_ticket_minutes`, and the batch size within `seeding.max_seeds_per_admission`. It must assert every existing fence path is existing Context and name each new path's registry owner. It must check predecessor-test closure for daemon-soak and exclude sibling-new paths and delimiter-bearing sources (`squatch/specs.py`) from Context. It must pin authoring-time Context sizes as synthetic fixtures and assert that a max-effort `specs/implement.md` render of each emitted seed stays within `RENDER_BOUND_CHARS['max'] * REQ_RENDER_HEADROOM`.
